config.goal: Test risk-ranking reliability under reactive traffic, not prove a new method.
config.decision_rule: Select highest nominal-progress nonfallback action whose method-specific risk upper score <=0.1; otherwise stop before intersection. Paired method additionally screens risk difference from coast.
config.data_split: Disjoint scene RNG streams for model fitting, calibration, test and deployment; test labels never inform method fitting or selection.
config.budget_unit: One complete candidate outcome from the analytical surrogate counts as one model call; deterministic uses only 5 useful calls; others use the exact stated cap. Offline calibration/reference/deployment calls and wall times are reported separately.
stop_rules: No-go for a novel-method claim if ensemble plus conventional simultaneous calibration meets the empirical risk criterion without material progress loss in ID.
No-go for an OOD guarantee claim if failure is only observed after violating calibration exchangeability.
No-go if improvements require near-universal fallback or extra unaccounted model/reference calls.
Toy evidence alone cannot justify a CCF B/A paper or a Plan-R1 benchmark deficiency claim.
config.reporting: Report all methods, strengths, domains and budgets; paired scene bootstrap CIs; no selection of best seed. CI coverage for model sampling is not coverage for physical-model misspecification.

conventions.cpu_seconds: perf_counter elapsed wall time for actual CPU-only NumPy/SciPy execution; selector time excludes reference/calibration; all components in ledger
conventions.reference: independent reactive evaluator, Monte Carlo estimates not exact physical truth
conventions.statistical_unit: scene within experiment seed; same scenes and exogenous deployment draws paired across methods
conventions.cpp_baselines: no full-paper implementation or paper-level guarantee claimed
